svg.title: How the website reaches GitHub Pages
svg.desc: The job docs, the required check, restores the downloads of Material from the cache of this ISO week and builds the website strictly, in every pull request and on main. Only a push saves the cache, once for each key. On main, where GitHub Pages publishes from the workflow, the same job hands the website that it built to GitHub Pages, with its files whose name starts with a dot, and a second job publishes it.
